MAPPLET.DESCRIPTION: Standardize email / segment / country (shared across customer loads).
MAPPLET.NAME: mplt_STD_CUSTOMER

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: SCD Type 2 load of DIM_CUSTOMER from the daily customer change feed.
MAPPING.NAME: m_DIM_CUSTOMER_SCD2

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Change-detection hash over the tracked SCD2 attributes.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_HASH

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Current dimension row per customer (SQL override computes the hash).
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_DIM_CURRENT

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT DIM_CUSTOMER.CUSTOMER_SK AS CUSTOMER_SK, DIM_CUSTOMER.CUSTOMER_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID, MD5(DIM_CUSTOMER.EMAIL || '|' || DIM_CUSTOMER.SEGMENT || '|' || DIM_CUSTOMER.COUNTRY) AS DIM_HASH FROM DIM_CUSTOMER WHERE DIM_CUSTOMER.CURRENT_FLAG = 'Y'

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: NEW and CHANGED rows; NOCHANGE falls into DEFAULT1 (not connected = dropped).
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: RTR_CHANGE

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Shared surrogate-key sequence, persisted Current Value = 1001.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: SEQ_CUSTOMER_SK

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Expire the previous current version (update keyed on CUSTOMER_SK).
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: UPD_EXPIRE_OLD

MAPPINGVARIABLE.DESCRIPTION: Business load date (YYYY-MM-DD), set in the parameter file.
MAPPINGVARIABLE.NAME: $$LOAD_DATE
